summary: Former Willamette National Forest lookout: crow's nest tree platforms from 1912, a cabin from 1944, removed in 1968. One crow's nest remained in 1996.

facts.design: Two crow's nest tree platforms and a camp (1912); frame cabin added 1944; new lookout house 1955
facts.status_note: The cabin was removed in 1968. One crow's nest remained as of 1996; no source says whether it still stands.

access.note: The Forest Service trailhead page, updated March 2025, lists the trailhead as open.

visit.trail_note: Directions run 2 miles north from Lowell on the Jasper-Lowell Road, turn right at the Unity Bridge, then 12.8 miles on Big Fall Creek Road (Forest Road 18). The trailhead provides access to Clark Butte Trail #3456.1. No tower stands; do not climb any remaining platform.

events.note: Two crow's nest tree platforms and a camp set up

corrections.why: The register and firelookout.com say one crow's nest remained on the site as of 1996, and the Oregon list marks the site Abandoned rather than Gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page dates removal of the lookout structure to 1968. The register says it was last used in the 1960s and that one crow's nest remained in 1996. Both can be true: the cabin came down and a tree platform was left.

notes_for_editor: Proposed correction: the record says status gone, but the register and firelookout.com say one crow's nest remained in 1996 and the Oregon list says Abandoned. Visit evidence is thin: one undated hiker trip report found no trace of the platforms, and the Forest Service page covers only the trailhead. The register lists the site as a platform, which matches the record's kind. The 1920-1922 staffing rests on one newspaper item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. Nothing describes the site's current condition beyond the 1996 note. The trailhead directions were corrected on 2026-10-09: they start in Lowell, and the 12.8 miles run on Big Fall Creek Road after the 2-mile leg and the Unity Bridge turn.
